explanation: Colour features came earlier: Becky Sharp (1935) was the first in full three-strip Technicolor. Oz used colour for effect, keeping its Kansas scenes in sepia.

claims.text: The Wizard of Oz (1939) was not the first feature film made in colour.
Becky Sharp (1935) was the first feature film made entirely in three-strip Technicolor.
The Kansas scenes of The Wizard of Oz are in sepia-toned black and white.
